verdict.rationale: LangGraph ships an official LangGraph CLI (pip-installable) documented for building and running the Agent Server locally, exposing API endpoints for runs/threads/assistants and including supporting services like managed DB for checkpointing — corroborated by first-party docs and a dedicated docs page/probe confirming its existence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of the CLI itself (community evidence discusses the framework broadly but not CLI usage specifically), and no detail on full command surface beyond serve/build.
